purpose: Positive regression fixture for a dense white wafer-paper side-wave curtain whose neighboring strip boundaries merge at image resolution.
observed_side_construction: one visible tier has a repeated, predominantly full-height curtain of narrow upright white sheets
at least two representative strips show thin sheet faces, loose free wavy edges, and separate attachment from the iced side
many neighboring strip boundaries merge at the supplied image resolution
the sheets appear white and unprinted

expected_support_element.description: conditioned white wafer paper strips softened and shaped into loose upright vertical waves around the cake side

forbidden_lookalikes: piped icing ridges, shells, fans, or rosettes
broad cupped or overlapping flower-petal ruffles
shadows, folds, or overlap boundaries without representative sheet faces and free edges
ivory, cream, beige, tan, colored, printed, or ambiguous sheets
